messages:
Maya Singh: Heads-up 1: Azure Marketplace invoice for Mar shows a duplicate consumption charge for BetaCorp under ResaleHub. Can finance cover?
Tome1s Ruiz: Please drop invoice ref and a snippet of the lines. I can reach out to ResaleHub ops.
Maya Singh: Invoice ref `AZ-INV-2026-03-BTC-5563`
Maya Singh: Lines exported:
```
line_id,product_code,description,charge
9872,AZ-RSL,ResaleHub - BetaCorp monthly,6420
9873,AZ-RSL,ResaleHub - BetaCorp monthly,6420
```
Nora Patel: We saw the same pattern last quarter but that was partner double-reporting. Do we have ResaleHub's usage report?
Maya Singh: Uploaded their usage bundle to /finance/shared/marketplace/az/AZ-INV-2026-03-BTC-5563.zip
billing-bot: Alert: potential duplicate consumption detected (2 identical charges). Suggested label: `marketplace-dup-consumption`.
Tome1s Ruiz: Pinged ResaleHub billing contact. Also opening Azure billing support case since invoice came from Microsoft billing pipeline.
ResaleHub Billing: Thanks for flagging. We show one record in our usage submissions. Uploading our audit log now. Could this be a Microsoft billing portal sync glitch?
Azure Marketplace Support: We've received your case. Can you confirm the ResaleHub partner id and the plan id? We'll check whether a reconciliation run created duplicate rows.
Maya Singh: Partner ID `RH-9001`, Plan `resale-premium-2025`.
Nora Patel: From accounting perspective: hold recognition of this invoice until Azure or ResaleHub issues correction. We'll mark it as disputed in the GL.
Tome1s Ruiz: Quick cashflow question: if Azure issues a credit, how long until it posts? Anyone seen timing?
ResaleHub Billing: We can issue a partner-level credit within 3 business days once Azure confirms. If Azure credits us, we'll forward the credit note.
Azure Marketplace Support: If this is a portal duplication, we typically issue a corrected invoice and a credit within 5-10 business days depending on workload. We'll prioritize if month-end hit.
Nora Patel: Month-end is in 4 days. I'll create a blocking entry in month-close and adjust reserves.
Maya Singh: Thanks. @Tome1s please paste the Azure support case ID here when created.
Tome1s Ruiz: Case AZR-2026-2249 opened. I'll add any updates and the audit logs from ResaleHub.
Maya Singh: Appreciate it. Also added note to BetaCorp customer record to avoid sending them duplicate copy invoices in our billing portal.
billing-bot: Reminder: please tag threads with `marketplace` + partner id for reporting.
Maya Singh: Will follow up every 6 hours until resolved. :hourglass:
